brief:
今日市场的主线是"AI 交易"在剧烈震荡后由 Nvidia 业绩暂时托住。公司销售额指引高于华尔街预期，半导体股从惩罚性抛售中反弹、美股期货回升，但金价跌至 14 个月低点、Fed 官员释放加息信号，说明资金同时在做两件事：追 AI 业绩，砍无息资产。中国方向，央行在 APEC 开幕日把人民币中间价调到 2022 年以来最强，被解读为对渐进升值的容忍；深圳的峰会经济也在同步展开，加拿大与中国扩容贸易协定，平安集团则公开表示将降低公开股票配置、转向固定收益。并购与融资同样活跃：Foxconn 拟收购索尼半导体车载摄像头模组业务，法国机器人公司 Genesis 以 35 亿美元估值融得 5 亿美元，芬兰 Iceye 出价 20 亿欧元竞购意大利火箭制造商 Avio。风险侧，IMF 对 AI 领域"循环融资"的警告，恰好给这轮由算力资本开支驱动的行情加了一行注脚。

1. **Nvidia 业绩指引超预期，芯片股与美股期货反弹** —— 销售展望高于市场预估，暂时缓解市场对 AI 资本开支可持续性的担忧，美债小幅走弱。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/stock-market-today-dow-s-p-live-updates)

2. **人民币中间价升至 2022 年以来最强** —— 央行在 APEC 开幕当天调高每日参考汇率，被视为对汇率渐进升值的默许。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-18/pboc-sets-strongest-yuan-fix-since-2022-to-allow-further-gains)

3. **金价跌至 14 个月低点，Fed 官员暗示加息** —— 加息压力上升叠加风险偏好回暖，让黄金的避险溢价被快速削减。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-17/gold-steadies-near-14-month-low-as-rate-hike-pressure-mounts)

4. **Foxconn 拟收购索尼半导体车载摄像头模组业务** —— 代工巨头继续向汽车电子纵深，摄像头模组是智能驾驶感知链的关键一环。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNZGJaT3hzb2NaLWVpNEw5Z29uaXZUYkNEUTNxck1XdmpULWo3SVY0MEVZbEVHMFkyUzRlcDUtYW9OOXNaMFV6MUVzMFJ6SFJwcmdlSFNWTmxuVjJ1UEtic1dUS0tVZ3pQYkxKOW1lelZ2TkxMUWFkV1JZMXYxTmhUQUpRZ1RybmJYZ3l1ZUU5Y1RxRng1dXd0MzY1eE4xOGxRSE8yQnF6MUxhQjIxZGVGbk5NOUFiS1JlNk5QcFBnWQ?oc=5)

5. **法国机器人公司 Genesis 以 35 亿美元估值融资 5 亿美元** —— 具身智能的融资热度仍在高位，资金正从模型层向"能动手"的公司集中。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNQlJMSlpCWFVKaDFXTDB6M1FBSnBqLUs4U3AzNXVTdXpNOHA2Z2hVVHVFdlNzUlNSNEhaMDlQUmcyUlhCcEN6ci1WUjU1MC1OV1NfYXhTQmFRQmo4U0FZWUxPSFdqNG9ubmptX1hVeVUtMDhVVlJGWkRVaXZydnBrMkNZS3pJRjFER1hFN2c2N3ZHNi1VVFFNVDVqY1dOS3M4NXBEOTdlSW9xczVtcE95bEdWbDBhNUxZZWYw?oc=5)

items.title: China Sets Strongest Yuan Fixing Since 2022 as APEC Begins
items.summary: China’s central bank lifted its daily yuan reference rate to the strongest in over four years, a sign of tolerance for gradual gains as it hosts a key regional summit.

items.title: Cobalt’s Outlook Darkens as Memory Chip Costs Hit Gadgets Demand
items.summary: Chinese cobalt demand is weakening as soaring prices for memory chips hit sales of the electronic gadgets that use the battery metal.

items.title: Ping An Group To Reduce Public Equity Allocation
items.summary: Michael Guo, Ping An Group Co-CEO says the insurance company is planning to reduce allocation on public equity and considering fixed income as an alternative investment. He speaks to Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle in an exclusive interview at the APEC 2026 summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Quant Trader Graviton Expands Office Space in India, Singapore
items.summary: Graviton Research Capital LLP has expanded into larger offices in India’s high-frequency trading hub of Gurugram and in Singapore as the homegrown firm gears up for an ambitious global expansion.

items.title: Gold Declines to 14-Month Low as Fed Officials Signal Rate Hikes
items.summary: Gold dropped to the lowest since September 2025 after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.

items.title: Stocks, US Futures Rebound After Nvidia Earnings: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Equities rebounded from a punishing rout in semiconductor shares after Nvidia Corp.’s sales forecast topped Wall Street estimates, assuaging some concerns about the artificial intelligence trade. Treasuries slipped.

items.title: SQM Sees Positive Lithium Demand Outlook Even as Prices Slide
items.summary: Major lithium producer SQM continues to see “encouraging trends” in underlying demand as the industry confronts a renewed selloff in the battery metal and the prospect of rising supply next year.

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 18
items.summary: Oil steadied as traders assessed renewed fighting in the Middle East against signs of recovering supplies and higher US inventories.

items.title: David Jones to Cut 1,500 Jobs in Survival Fight, Union Says
items.summary: Australian department store chain David Jones is set to cut about 1,500 jobs, one-quarter of the workforce, as it shuts outlets in a bid to survive, according to the employees’ union.

items.title: Fidelity Says Even at 6% Treasuries Fail to Be ‘Massively Cheap’
items.summary: The recent selloff in Treasuries has sparked debate about buying opportunities, but Fidelity International’s Salman Ahmed reckons that even a 6% yield wouldn’t make the 10-year note “massively cheap.”

items.title: The Pentagon Urgently Needs More Patriot Missiles. It’s Running Into a Rayon Problem.
items.summary: A humble fabric is snarling production plans for the crucial defense system, one of myriad chokepoints in the U.S. munitions industry.

items.title: Le Pen’s Lead in French Election Race Has EU in Scramble for Funding
items.summary: EU leaders face a year-end deadline to agree on $2.2 trillion in future funding and aid for Ukraine before France’s presidential election.

items.title: A Hunger Crisis Is Making Ebola Even Deadlier
items.summary: The outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that is increasing the chances of death for people who catch the virus.

items.title: Can a New Leader Make the U.N. Relevant Again?
items.summary: Two veteran diplomats have garnered the most attention in the race to succeed Secretary-General António Guterres. A key vote is set for Thursday.

items.title: European Defense Chief Snaps at Pentagon Official Over Ukraine Criticism
items.summary: A NATO meeting aimed at boosting unity in support of Ukraine turned snippy when a top European defense chief called a U.S. official’s criticism of Kyiv’s strikes “stupid.”

items.title: Canada and China Draw Closer with Expanded Trade Pact
items.summary: Deal is part of Prime Minister Mark Carney’s efforts to become less dependent on the U.S.

items.title: Oil Edges Lower as Supply Surplus Prospects Offset Mideast Tensions
items.summary: Oil edged lower as supply surplus prospects offset Middle East tensions.

items.title: JGBs Edge Lower Ahead of 20-Year Auction
items.summary: JGBs edged lower in price terms ahead of the Japanese finance ministry’s auction of about 700 billion yen of 20-year government bonds.

items.title: Trump Returns to World Stage After Midterm Setback
items.summary: Allies and rivals are watching the president’s Asia tour for clues on how he will wield his power abroad during the rest of his term.

items.title: Nvidia Forms National-Security Committee After Huang’s Exit
items.summary: The move is one of the first after a geopolitical firestorm over former CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

items.summary: 特朗普表示对黄仁勋复出持开放态度。董事会表示，在遴选新任首席执行官时，将同时考虑内部和外部候选人。

items.summary: 特朗普、习近平和普京将在周四举行史无前例的三方会晤，这已引起国际社会的密切关注。

items.title: 科技投资者：“成功和名望”损害硅谷企业领导水平
items.summary: 英国知名基金经理安德森严厉批评硅谷盛行的“强势创始人-领导者”模式。他警告，黄仁勋和马斯克等人的超级明星地位有损企业领导水平。

items.title: 欧盟再度推动AI治理全球协议
items.summary: 欧盟迄今未能说服特朗普加入一项关于AI治理的国际协议。然而，特朗普在中期选举中受挫，一定程度上突显了美国选民对AI和数据中心的担忧。

items.title: 极地涡旋提前崩溃令人担忧寒冬
items.summary: 通常困住北极冷空气的极地涡旋出现有记录以来最早的冬季崩溃，科学家担心欧洲、北美和北亚出现极度寒冷干燥的天气，但目前影响尚不明确。

items.title: 纽约社会主义者组织支持奥卡西奥-科尔特斯竞选总统
items.summary: 37岁的奥卡西奥-科尔特斯是新一代左翼代表人物，得到美国民主社会主义者协会纽约市分会的支持。她本人尚未表态会否竞选总统。

items.title: 俄罗斯要求欧洲挑选一名代表参与俄乌和谈
items.summary: 按照俄方设想，这一人选还必须获得普京的认可。此前特朗普女婿库什纳在莫斯科与俄总统会面后称，普京愿“尝试”让欧洲参与谈判。
